name: Free consultation call
description: A short call with a clinician to talk about what you're looking for and whether the practice is a good fit. Not a therapy session.
keywords: free consult phone call fit first step getting started new client

name: Individual therapy - first session (intake)
description: The first full session with your clinician: getting to know each other, paperwork review, and setting goals together.
keywords: intake assessment first appointment initial session adult

name: Individual therapy
description: Ongoing one-on-one sessions for adults, usually weekly or every other week.
keywords: counseling talk therapy one on one adult weekly

name: Extended individual session
description: A longer one-on-one session, scheduled when you and your clinician agree it's useful.

name: Couples counseling - first session
description: A first session with both partners to understand goals and how you'd like to work together.
keywords: couples marriage relationship partners premarital intake

name: Couples counseling
description: Ongoing sessions for couples, married or not, at any stage of a relationship.
keywords: couples marriage counseling relationship partners premarital

name: Family therapy
description: Sessions with two or more family members, including parents and children or adult family members.
keywords: family parents siblings household blended family

name: Teen therapy (ages 13-17)
description: One-on-one sessions for teenagers, with periodic check-ins with a parent or guardian. A parent or guardian books and completes consent.
keywords: teen teenager adolescent high school middle school youth

name: Parent consultation session
description: A session for parents or guardians on their own, to talk through parenting questions or a child's care plan.

name: EMDR therapy session
format: In-person preferred; telehealth for some clients
description: Sessions with an EMDR-trained clinician. Whether EMDR is a fit is discussed with the clinician first.

name: Extended EMDR session
description: A longer EMDR session, scheduled by the clinician when appropriate.

name: Women's support group
description: A small, clinician-led group that meets weekly. A short screening call with the group leader comes first.

name: Telehealth individual session
description: Individual therapy by secure video for clients located in Indiana at the time of the session.
keywords: telehealth online video virtual remote zoom

name: Reduced-fee session (sliding scale)
description: A limited number of reduced-fee spots for individual therapy. Discussed privately with the clinician during the free consultation.
keywords: sliding scale reduced fee low cost affordable discount

name: Letters and documentation
description: Letters or forms for current clients, prepared by the clinician when appropriate. Requests go through the office.
keywords: letter form documentation paperwork records request
